description: Where the warehouse spends: bytes read per user / dashboard / query pattern from system.query_log, dbt run cost, and the costlab benchmark + modeled bill. ClickHouse stands in for Snowflake: bytes and times are measured, credits and dollars are modeled.

panels.title: Query log: who reads the bytes
Bytes read
panels.description: Uncompressed bytes read by finished queries, all users. The closest thing ClickHouse has to 'bytes scanned'.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=bytes-read-total */
SELECT sum(read_bytes) AS bytes_read
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=queries-total */
SELECT count() AS queries
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=query-duration-p95 */
SELECT quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: Grafana share of bytes read
panels.description: Dashboards vs everything else (loader, dbt, costlab, admin). Includes this dashboard's own queries.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=grafana-share */
SELECT sumIf(read_bytes, user = 'grafana') / nullIf(sum(read_bytes), 0) AS grafana_share
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: Bytes read per hour by user
panels.description: One ClickHouse user per tool (loader, dbt, grafana, costlab), like a warehouse per workload. Queries from this dashboard are split out as 'grafana (this dashboard)'.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=bytes-by-user */
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(event_time) AS time,
  multiIf(user = 'grafana' AND extract(query, 'dashboard=([a-z0-9-]+)') = 'warehouse-cost',
          'grafana (this dashboard)', user) AS who,
  sum(read_bytes) AS bytes_read
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time, who
ORDER BY time

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=queries-by-user */
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time,
  multiIf(user = 'grafana' AND extract(query, 'dashboard=([a-z0-9-]+)') = 'warehouse-cost',
          'grafana (this dashboard)', user) AS who,
  count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS queries_per_min
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time, who
ORDER BY time

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=duration-by-user */
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time,
  user,
  quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time, user
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Bytes read per Grafana dashboard
panels.description: Every panel's SQL starts with /* grafana dashboard=<uid> panel=<slug> */, which survives into query_log. With BI auto-refresh off this only grows when someone opens a dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=bytes-by-dashboard */
SELECT
  extract(query, 'dashboard=([a-z0-9-]+)') AS dashboard,
  sum(read_bytes) AS bytes_read
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND user = 'grafana'
  AND dashboard != ''
GROUP BY dashboard
ORDER BY bytes_read DESC

panels.title: Top query patterns by bytes read
panels.description: Queries grouped by normalized_query_hash (same SQL shape, literals stripped), heaviest first. This dashboard's own queries are excluded. Lever 1 starts here: a cheap query run 96x a day adds up.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=top-query-patterns */
SELECT
  hex(normalized_query_hash) AS pattern,
  user,
  extract(any(query), 'dashboard=([a-z0-9-]+)') AS dashboard,
  extract(any(query), 'panel=([a-z0-9-]+)') AS panel,
  count() AS runs,
  sum(read_bytes) AS bytes_read,
  sum(read_bytes) / count() AS bytes_per_run,
  avg(query_duration_ms) AS avg_ms,
  substring(replaceRegexpAll(any(query), '[[:space:]]+', ' '), 1, 160) AS sample
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__fromTime) AND event_date <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND NOT (user = 'grafana' AND query LIKE '%dashboard=warehouse-cost %')
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash, user
ORDER BY bytes_read DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Lever 3: dbt runs (incremental vs full refresh)
Bytes read: latest run per mode
panels.description: Most recent successful run of each mode, whenever it happened (not limited to the time range).

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=dbt-latest-bytes */
SELECT mode, read_bytes
FROM costlab.dbt_runs
WHERE (mode, started_at) IN (
  SELECT mode, max(started_at)
  FROM costlab.dbt_runs
  WHERE status = 'success'
  GROUP BY mode
)
ORDER BY mode

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=dbt-latest-duration */
SELECT mode, duration_s
FROM costlab.dbt_runs
WHERE (mode, started_at) IN (
  SELECT mode, max(started_at)
  FROM costlab.dbt_runs
  WHERE status = 'success'
  GROUP BY mode
)
ORDER BY mode

panels.title: Bytes read per dbt run
panels.description: Each point is one `dbt run` (all models), summed from query_log by its log_comment run tag.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=dbt-bytes-per-run */
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  mode,
  read_bytes
FROM costlab.dbt_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY time

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=dbt-duration-per-run */
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  mode,
  duration_s
FROM costlab.dbt_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY time

/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=dbt-recent-runs */
SELECT
  started_at,
  mode,
  triggered_by,
  status,
  query_count AS queries,
  read_rows,
  read_bytes,
  written_rows,
  written_bytes,
  duration_s
FROM costlab.dbt_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Lever 2: partitioned + clustered fact table (latest bench-scan)
Partitioned vs unpartitioned
panels.description: Same BI panel SQL replayed against analytics.fct_events (partitioned by month, ordered by event_date, ...) and a copy with no partitioning and ORDER BY tuple(). Shown as a share of the unpartitioned cost.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=bench-summary */
SELECT
  sumIf(read_bytes, layout = 'partitioned') / nullIf(sumIf(read_bytes, layout = 'unpartitioned'), 0) AS bytes_read,
  sumIf(duration_ms, layout = 'partitioned') / nullIf(sumIf(duration_ms, layout = 'unpartitioned'), 0) AS query_time,
  max(run_at) AS measured
FROM costlab.bench_queries
WHERE run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, run_at) FROM costlab.bench_queries)
HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: Per panel: bytes read and time by layout
panels.description: Median of N runs per panel and layout. 'share read' = partitioned bytes / unpartitioned bytes.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=bench-per-panel */
SELECT
  dashboard,
  panel,
  sumIf(read_bytes, layout = 'unpartitioned') AS unpartitioned_bytes,
  sumIf(read_bytes, layout = 'partitioned') AS partitioned_bytes,
  partitioned_bytes / nullIf(unpartitioned_bytes, 0) AS share_read,
  sumIf(duration_ms, layout = 'unpartitioned') AS unpartitioned_ms,
  sumIf(duration_ms, layout = 'partitioned') AS partitioned_ms
FROM costlab.bench_queries
WHERE run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, run_at) FROM costlab.bench_queries)
GROUP BY dashboard, panel
ORDER BY unpartitioned_bytes DESC

panels.title: Modeled USD / day per step
panels.description: Each step applies one lever on top of the previous ones (0 = baseline). Bars are stacked by warehouse. Modeled Snowflake-style billing from measured query times: credits x $3.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=scenario-usd-per-step */
SELECT
  concat(toString(step), '. ', scenario) AS step_label,
  sumIf(usd, warehouse = 'reporting') AS reporting,
  sumIf(usd, warehouse = 'transform') AS transform,
  sumIf(usd, warehouse = 'live') AS live
FROM costlab.scenario_costs
WHERE run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, run_at) FROM costlab.scenario_costs)
GROUP BY step, scenario
ORDER BY step

panels.title: Bill: baseline vs all levers
panels.description: Modeled USD per day at step 0 vs the last step, and the saving. "saved" is the Snowflake-style (warehouse time) bill; "saved if priced per TiB" prices the same modeled day per byte scanned.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=scenario-summary */
SELECT
  argMin(usd, step) AS baseline,
  argMax(usd, step) AS after_levers,
  1 - after_levers / nullIf(baseline, 0) AS saved,
  1 - argMax(scan_usd, step) / nullIf(argMin(scan_usd, step), 0) AS scan_saved
FROM
(
  SELECT step, sum(usd) AS usd, sum(scan_usd) AS scan_usd
  FROM costlab.scenario_costs
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, run_at) FROM costlab.scenario_costs)
  GROUP BY step
)
HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: Scenario detail
panels.description: billed_seconds includes the 60s minimum per resume and the auto-suspend tail after the last query.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=scenario-detail */
SELECT
  step,
  scenario,
  warehouse,
  queries,
  bytes_scanned,
  busy_seconds,
  billed_seconds,
  credits,
  usd,
  scan_usd
FROM costlab.scenario_costs
WHERE run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, run_at) FROM costlab.scenario_costs)
ORDER BY step, warehouse

properties.value: USD / day if priced per TiB

panels.title: Table sizes
panels.description: Active parts only. Compressed = what's on disk; uncompressed is roughly what a full scan reads.

targets.rawSql:
/* grafana dashboard=warehouse-cost panel=table-sizes */
SELECT
  concat(database, '.', table) AS table_name,
  uniqExact(partition) AS partitions,
  count() AS parts,
  sum(rows) AS rows,
  sum(data_compressed_bytes) AS compressed,
  sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) AS uncompressed,
  uncompressed / nullIf(compressed, 0) AS ratio
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
  AND database IN ('raw', 'analytics', 'costlab')
GROUP BY database, table
ORDER BY compressed DESC
